title: JavaScript Programming Track
description: Master JavaScript from the ground up. Learn the language of the web — from core syntax and data structures to async programming, the DOM, and modern ES6+ features used in production applications.

moduleDetails.title: JavaScript Fundamentals
moduleDetails.description: Variables, data types, operators, arrays, objects, and control flow.

moduleDetails.title: Functions, Scope & ES6+
moduleDetails.description: Functions, arrow functions, closures, destructuring, spread, and modules.

moduleDetails.title: The DOM & Events
moduleDetails.description: Querying the DOM, manipulating elements, and handling browser events.

moduleDetails.title: Async JavaScript & APIs
moduleDetails.description: Promises, async/await, Fetch API, error handling, and localStorage.
